Rubric-change impact preview

/teach/courses/:courseId/rubrics/:rubricId/change-preview
Roles: instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: S18

Compare a rubric candidate against affected held grading before an instructor applies a precise versioned change.

Entry and return
W44 in-use editW49 propose rubric changeW43 usage review
Layout regions
Rule comparisonOld/new criterion descriptors, scores and version IDs
Impact tableLearner/question, old/new calculated score, override kept, unscored and released excluded
DecisionFuture-only or selected held recalculation, preview fingerprint and proposal history

States (4)
Wording only
WhenNo score values/rules change
ShowsShow zero score effect, version still changes
Way outApply wording version
Manual overrides present
WhenAffected rows contain manual scores
ShowsSeparate kept count with author/reason

ShowsList excluded immutable snapshots

WhenScore, rubric or scope changes after preview
ShowsWho/what/time diff and Apply disabled

Dialogs and drawers (1)
Apply rubric version
  • Version diff, recalculated held rows, overrides kept and released rows excluded
  • No automatic release; each changed result remains staff-only
Return without applying changesApply exact reviewed change
Permissions
  • Course-only instructor authority.
  • TA access requires assigned learners/questions, expiry and explicit extra grants; authoring defaults off.
  • TA cannot release, change policy or grant allowances.
Responsive
  • Wide: work/checks side by side. Narrow: labelled stacked sections.
  • At 320px use one panel; tables scroll within labelled regions.
Accessibility
  • Semantic headings/labels, visible focus, text status; restore dialog focus.
  • Link errors to fields; announce saves. Support zoom/reduced motion.
Data
  • Fictional local records; zone/version timestamps.
  • Permission-filter data; uncertain writes remain unconfirmed.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • Recalculation changes eligible held rubric-derived scores only.
  • Manual overrides and every released snapshot remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
  • TA and stale-preview attempts fail with an explained block and no partial score updates.
Notes
  • NEW PROPOSED web template; legacy IDs/map unchanged.
  • HTML planning only; no backend/integrations.
